brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
hey @buildthis.bisks.net sorry if my tone was too much, I mean I really appreciate what you’re doing here, would you please make the drone accounts selectable / randomized?

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@antiali.as: jesus christ @buildthis.bisks.net can you make it so i can randomize or select the accounts that show up in the drone?
note: mootdrone now shows a picker after loading a network — check/uncheck accounts (max 8), hit 🎲 randomize, or reselect the lineup anytime from the board without retyping the handle.
